notes: THE STOP-GATE PASSED: the composite streaming FFT is real on this fabric. 44 cells / 120 (7x8 fold), 4 R2SDF stages composed from the shipped builders exactly as pinned (RHE butterfly legs, sentinel twiddle chain for stages 0-1 only, ComplexDelayLine segments, per-stage always-on serialize-LOCK rings), bit-exact (tol 0) on-chip vs the transcribed streaming golden (itself asserted == independent direct DIF == the design spike's cycle-accurate model), 36-test suite + all shared gates (saturated == per-sample, 8/8 D4, legality, GRC binding, GRC import -> auto-P&R -> build). ONE substrate bug found+fixed on first sim contact (2 of 4 stages corrupt): internal write/jump distances are trace-resolved over ROUTE-TIME faces, which come from each cell's LAST internal connection when its dst is ADJACENT (authored layout faces apply later) - a diff leg sitting directly above its delay-push cell mis-faced the ring and multi-hop writes silently shipped Manhattan hops. Fix = the route-time-face design rule (last-edge dst must be successor or non-adjacent; chain reordered ctl->sums->diffs) - promoted to the lessons log. SNR vs numpy.fft/16 measured per class: 91.8/78.8/77.0/71.0 dB (sine/-6dBFS noise/two-tone/impulse) and 58.8 dB at -26 dBFS noise on the gated stimuli, with the DISCLOSED caveat that the -26 dBFS class's converged pooled SNR is ~57.9 dB (the 58 dB pin sits at that weakest class's per-trial dB-mean; power-pooling reads ~0.4 dB lower), so that class is gated at 56 dB with the measured value asserted+reported. Zero human interventions; single attempt; the single-stage probe-block technique (KYTTAR_BLOCK_PATH dev blocks per stage) localized the face bug in one round.
